question: Circles with centers \( O \) and \( P \) have radii \( 2 \) and \( 4 \), respectively, and are externally tangent. Points \( A \) and \( B \) on the circle with center \( O \) and points \( C \) and \( D \) on the circle with center \( P \) are such that \( AD \) and \( BC \) are common external tangents to the circles. Find the area of the concave hexagon \( AOBCPD \). The original answer is in the form \( k\sqrt{m} \). Please provide the value of \( k + m \).

spans.label: [EXECUTION.OPERATION.ARITHMETIC-COMPUTATION]
spans.text: in our case, R is 4, r is 2, so 2*sqrt(4*2) = 2*sqrt(8) = 4*sqrt(2).

spans.label: [RETRIEVAL.RECALL]
spans.text: the tangent line is common to both circles, the radii to the tangent points are perpendicular to the tangent line. So OA is perpendicular to AD, and PD is perpendicular to AD.
